offering_description.value: Legence provides engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance for mission-critical buildings in technology, life sciences, healthcare, and education. It designs, fabricates, and installs HVAC, process piping, and other building systems and upgrades equipment and controls in existing facilities.

quotes.quote: We are a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. We focus on high-growth sectors with technically demanding buildings, including technology, life sciences, healthcare, and education.

We offer a range of solutions inclusive of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services. We specialize in designing, fabricating and installing HVAC, process piping and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems for new facilities and upgrading HVAC, lighting, and building controls in existing facilities to make them more energy efficient and sustainable.

primary_services.value: Building systems engineering; energy and sustainability consulting; project management; system installation and retrofits; preventive and corrective maintenance

quotes.quote: Our Engineering & Consulting teams design HVAC and MEP systems, develop energy-saving strategies to make buildings more sustainable, and provide program/project management services for customers’ installation and retrofit projects.

Our Installation & Maintenance technicians and craftspeople fabricate and install HVAC systems, process piping and other MEP systems in new and existing industrial, commercial, and institutional buildings and provide ongoing preventative and corrective maintenance services for those systems.

customer_segment.value: B2B: Data center operators, manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, schools, and universities; B2G: Government research facilities

quotes.quote: Our business is growing rapidly as data centers, manufacturers, pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, schools, and universities make investments in both new and existing facilities to support growing demand for their products and services, reduce energy costs, and increase resiliency. Our innovative approach breaks down traditional industry barriers, establishing Legence as a trusted partner for organizations striving to meet high-performance goals and drive progress toward a healthier, more sustainable future.
